3-2-1: On following your dreams, making the first right choice, and how to handle a storm

Read on

 JAMESCLEAR.COM | NOVEMBER 12, 2026

Happy 3-2-1 Thursday!

Here are 3 ideas, 2 quotes, and 1 question to consider this week...

​

3 Ideas From Me

I.

"Talent is a gift. Effort is a choice."

​II.

"It won't solve every problem in life, but it is surprising how different my mindset is when I'm sleeping well and exercising regularly."

III.

"When learning, explore widely.

When mastering, focus narrowly."

​

2 Quotes From Others

I.

Novelist and writer Louisa May Alcott reminds us that the key is not avoiding hardship:

"I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning how to sail my ship."

Source: Little Women

​II.

Writer and naturalist Henry David Thoreau on following your dreams:

"Endeavor to live the life which you have imagined."

Source: Walden

​

1 Question For You

I met with the crew of NASA's Artemis II moon mission earlier this week and they told me there was a question they kept returning to:

"What is the first right thing I can do?"

Until next week, and remember: small habits make a big difference over the years.

 

James Clear

Author of   
 Atomic Habits and The Book 
Creator of the Habit Journal
